MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: normal volatility at 31.2% and broad participation, with 7/8 sectors positive. Breadth is supportive, although volatility remains above the low-volatility threshold.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +15.28%), ABOVE TREND; PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) and THYAO (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +14.68%) are both ABOVE TREND. Banking & Finance is also ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +4.29%), led by GARAN (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.17%), ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment is the sole sector with negative weekly breadth and is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -2.64%); DOHOL (1W: -6.38% | 1M: -6.69%) is BELOW TREND. Retail & Food is only marginally positive this week and remains in RECOVERY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -7.51%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) is ABOVE TREND; CCOLA (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -0.93%), TCELL (1W: +7.78% | 1M: -1.32%), and KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%) are in RECOVERY. ALARK (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +0.74%) is ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
TRMET (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -14.31%), GUBRF (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -27.24%), and AEFES (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -9.27%) are BELOW TREND. SAHOL (1W: -2.41% | 1M: +0.53%) is in CORRECTION, while ARCLK (1W: -2.92% | 1M: -11.04%) is BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly advances were PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%), ABOVE TREND; CCOLA (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -0.93%), in RECOVERY; and TCELL (1W: +7.78% | 1M: -1.32%), in RECOVERY. KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%) also posted a strong bounce but remains in RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is ABOVE TREND, with 1W sector returns of +2.07% and 1M returns of +4.29%. GARAN (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.17%), AKBNK (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +4.25%), ISCTR (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +4.15%), and YKBNK (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +5.12%) are all ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -7.44%), with the weekly rebound not yet reversing the monthly weakness. EREGL (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -11.86%), KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%), and ASELS (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -0.72%) are in RECOVERY; FROTO (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +2.64%) is ABOVE TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.80% | 1M: -13.35%), with a sharp divergence between weekly gains and monthly losses. TUPRS (1W: +6.37% | 1M: -8.18%) is in RECOVERY, while TRMET (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -14.31%), GUBRF (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -27.24%), and HEKTS (1W: -4.55% | 1M: -20.38%) are BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a selective risk-on stance, emphasizing transportation and banks, the strongest sectors by weekly performance and quant rankings. Keep exposure disciplined: the monthly weakness in several sectors and normal—not low—volatility argue against broad, indiscriminate risk-taking.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) and THYAO (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +14.68%) are ABOVE TREND; GARAN (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.17%) is also ABOVE TREND. Watch whether TUPRS (1W: +6.37% | 1M: -8.18%) and KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%) can extend their RECOVERY moves.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +15.28%), ABOVE TREND, and Banking & Finance (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +4.29%), ABOVE TREND, for leadership follow-through. Energy & Chemicals (1W: +0.80% | 1M: -13.35%), in RECOVERY, is the key test of whether weekly strength can broaden.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels were provided, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated reliably. Track the index’s prior-week high and low, alongside whether leadership in transportation and banking persists and whether sector breadth holds near 7/8.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

BIST is RISK-ON, supported by normal volatility and positive breadth across 7/8 sectors; transportation and banking lead, both ABOVE TREND. The main risks are persistent monthly weakness across several sectors and pronounced laggards in holdings, retail, and parts of energy and chemicals.
